And this isn't just an internal efficiency issue.
Every one of us supports a customer in some way.
That might be an external business partner.
It might be a retail banking customer.
Or it might be another Northpointe employee.
And that last one matters more than we sometimes realize.
Because when we help our internal teams get what they need faster, we're helping them serve their customers faster.
Imagine someone in Sales is working with a borrower and suddenly can't access a system they need.
If that request turns into multiple emails back and forth just to figure out which application they need help with, that's time.
And while they're waiting, their customer is waiting too.
A better support experience internally can have a very real impact externally.
